title: VideoTranscriptRAGInput
description: Input payload for the Video Transcript Temporal RAG skill.

transcript.description: Standard Whisper JSON object, segments array, flat word list, or SRT/VTT formatted string.

query.description: User question, search query, or summary command (e.g., 'what video about', 'When was X mentioned?').

video_title.description: Optional title or topic label of the video for contextual grounding.

video_id.description: Optional unique identifier for the video.

allow_mock.description: Explicitly authorize MockProvider for offline testing. Default false.
